question_text: Describe how a LIFO stack supports returning to interrupted work when nested interrupt handling has completed.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: The saved return information/state for each interruption is pushed. Popping the most recently saved state first resumes the most recently interrupted work in the reverse order of suspension.

marking_points.criterion: Pop latest state first to resume in reverse order.
